purpose: Illustrative synthetic known-answer test for induced voltage and quasi-DC current in a tiny declared network. This example is not measured event data or an operational assessment.

scenarios.event_or_fixture: Uniform constant E-field over one straight oriented conductor
scenarios.description: Known-answer sign and magnitude test; line reversal must reverse induced-voltage sign.

datasets.title: Synthetic uniform geoelectric field fixture
datasets.time_basis: UTC fixture timestamps; constant field over declared interval
datasets.unit_statement: Electric field in V/m; conductor path in m; induced voltage in V

models.name: Analytic straight-line induced-voltage oracle
models.validity_domain: Uniform E field and straight line segment only
models.uncertainty_method: Exact synthetic parameters; floating-point tolerance predeclared by test harness
known_limitations: Not a geomagnetic-field or conductivity solver

spatial_scope.name: Synthetic local Cartesian fixture
spatial_scope.crs: Declared local Cartesian XYZ; no geographic CRS
spatial_scope.geomagnetic_frame_policy: No geomagnetic frame is used in this analytic example

grid_case.line_path_convention: Path is oriented from node i to node j; V_ij is integral E dot dl from i to j

leakage_controls: Synthetic truth is fixed before implementation comparison

negative_controls.mutation: Reverse conductor path orientation without changing E field.
negative_controls.failure_mode: The signed voltage should reverse; unchanged sign reveals orientation error.

negative_controls.mutation: Provide E in mV/km while declaring V/m.
negative_controls.failure_mode: Unit mismatch must not be silently accepted.
No path integral can be computed.

authority_boundary.notes: Synthetic offline reference fixture only. It cannot issue grid commands or establish physical safety.

expected_targets.target: 100% of frozen tiny-network fixtures agree within predeclared tolerance
expected_targets.qualification: Project gate only; requires independent test oracle and exact-head receipt.

notes: Example is a manifest-shape illustration, not a result.
All dataset and model URIs must be pinned to specific immutable releases or commit references before a real benchmark run.
